primary.title: Dividend buzz: Dalmia Bharat, Mazagon Dock, Coal India, NTPC, others to consider payouts this week - Check full list
primary.summary: Several companies, including REC, Coal India, NTPC and Godrej Consumer, are set to announce September-quarter results and dividends. Meanwhile, Indian equities ended lower on Friday, with the Nifty 50 down 0.39% and its technical outlook remaining weak.
